requirement: tracy_demo check runs in the background on tracy-web and dsh polls its result, so a check longer than the edge's ~100 s still reaches the agent and is counted once

oracle.ref: PR #1666 (fix); fix evidence: dev 24/10/2026: every tracy_demo check answered Cloudflare 524; the action stayed queued/fill
oracle.invariant: S1: start answers running at once with one checkId; the second start joins it; status is running and nothing is counted yet; after the look finishes status carries pass:false and the looks-finished check under the same checkId, counted exactly once; after the action closes status still answers that checkId and check.start is AGENT_DEMO_ACTION_CLOSED; the silent check is DEMO_CHECK_LOST and not counted. S2: sends check.start then check.status until the result; falls back to one synchronous check; answers start's refusal or result without polling; DEMO_CHECK_RUNNING with running:true; TURN_STOPPED after one send; two failed polls are ridden through, six in a row are the answer, DEMO_CHECK_LOST is the answer at once.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command
